# Rose Practice Solutions

> Rose Practice Solutions is a fully remote marketing company in the United States for orthodontic practices first, with dental practices welcome. What it sells is the Core Marketing Plan: websites and SEO, plus Google and Meta ads management. Patient follow-up is a monthly add-on to the Core Marketing Plan that any client can ask about: a patient concierge calls and texts new leads and past leads, at calling hours set per practice, and books the consult into the practice's own patient management software. Its sales team decides whether it fits the practice. Projects are sold on their own, each priced for the practice: brand and logo work, video and content, and a website without the ads. Reputation management and dental consulting are coming soon. Plans start at $2,000 a month; ad spend is separate, paid to Google and Meta. Patient follow-up as an add-on is from $500 a month, priced by lead count. The team is five founders, by title: Follow-up, Sales, Operations, Web and SEO, and Paid media. The team has 60+ years of combined dental and orthodontic experience. One of our founders replies within one business day.

## Key facts

- How much does orthodontic marketing cost at Rose Practice Solutions? The Core Marketing Plan is $2,000 a month for one or two locations, $2,500 for three and $3,000 for four or more. Ad spend is separate, paid to Google and Meta from ad accounts in the practice's name. The same prices apply to dental practices.
- What does an orthodontic marketing company do? It gets the practice found by families nearby and gives them a reason to ask for a consult. At Rose Practice Solutions that is a website built from the practice, a new local page every month, the Google Business Profile kept current, and Google and Meta ads aimed at patients ready to start treatment.
- Does Rose Practice Solutions work with dentists? Yes. Most of its work is built around orthodontic practices, and dental practices are welcome, on the same plan, at the same price. It works with privately owned practices, usually one to three locations.
- What is patient follow-up? An add-on to the Core Marketing Plan: a patient concierge calls and texts the practice's new and past leads, within calling hours set per practice, and books the consult into the practice's own patient management software. How long it keeps trying is agreed with the practice at the start. From $500 a month for up to 15 leads, $800 for up to 30, $1,250 for up to 60 and $1,750 for up to 100.
- Terms: the first 90 days from launch are a commitment, then month to month with 30 days' notice. One agreement, one invoice.
- Ownership: the practice owns the website, the domain and the content, and the Google and Meta ad accounts are in its own name.
- Reporting: every month, what we did, what it brought in, and what we're changing next. The work is judged by consults booked, not by how many leads came in. No patient count is promised.

## Questions to ask any orthodontic marketing agency

- Who will we actually talk to? The founders who do the work. One of our founders replies within one business day.
- Who owns the website and the ad accounts? You do. The website, the domain and the content are yours, and the Google and Meta ad accounts are in your practice's name.
- What do you report on? Consults booked, not clicks. Every month you get what we did, what it brought in, and what we're changing next.
- What happens after the phone rings? Your team answers, and each consult is traced back to the ad that brought it. With the patient follow-up add-on, a patient concierge calls and texts your leads under your practice's name.
- How long is the contract? 90 days from launch, then month to month with 30 days' notice.
